tables.name: child
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE child (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  parent_id BIGINT REFERENCES parent ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL,
  other_id INTEGER REFERENCES missing DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (amount >= 0 AND amount <= 100.5),
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('untitled') CHECK (length(title) >= 1 AND length(title) <= 80),
  kind TEXT CHECK (kind IN ('a', 'b''c')),
  flag BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  made TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  payload,
  ratio DOUBLE PRECISION,
  body TEXT,
  search_text TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(body, '')) STORED,
  CHECK (amount < ratio),
  CONSTRAINT kind_or_flag CHECK (kind IS NOT NULL OR flag)
)

indexes.name: child_by_parent
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX child_by_parent ON child (parent_id DESC)

indexes.name: child_kind_title
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX child_kind_title ON child (kind, lower(title))

indexes.name: child_title_lower
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX child_title_lower ON child (lower(title)) WHERE kind = 'a'

indexes.name: child_title_nocase
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX child_title_nocase ON child (title COLLATE NOCASE)

tables.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE child_fts USING fts5(title, body)

tables.name: parent
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE parent (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
  label VARCHAR(40) COLLATE RTRIM,
  UNIQUE (code, label)
)

views.name: child_titles
views.sql: CREATE VIEW child_titles AS SELECT id, title FROM child

triggers.name: child_fts_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER child_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON child
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO child_fts (rowid, title, body) VALUES (NEW.rowid, NEW.title, NEW.body);
END

triggers.name: trg_child_bump_version
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER "trg_child_bump_version" AFTER UPDATE ON "child" FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.amount = OLD.amount BEGIN UPDATE "child" SET amount = OLD.amount + 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
